_comment: FOMC rate-decision ANNOUNCEMENT days only -- the SECOND day of each two-day meeting, when the statement is released at 14:00 ET. Source: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm
_notes: 2027 is TENTATIVE -- the Fed states each date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it. Notation votes (e.g. 2025-08-22) are NOT included: no rate decision, no 14:00 statement. Unscheduled emergency meetings cannot be listed in advance and are not covered by this table.
